testcase.name: late confirmed error corrects a generic COMPLETED but never cancellation
confirmed completion persists COMPLETED and survives reopen
confirmed error is FAILED and generic completion cannot overwrite it
confirmed cancellation keeps COMPLETED lifecycle with cancelled reason
stale generation and superseded declarations never terminate
a wrong execution id cannot mutate another execution
terminal event for an unknown execution changes nothing
progress after terminal is NotApplicable and never regresses
disconnect without terminal evidence fabricates no completion
healthy progress on a RUNNING row is NotApplicable not buffered evidence
